PUBLIC INFORMATION

The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council ,
other than closed session matters, prior to any action taken on the agenda.
Because of the threat of COVID-19 (aka the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take
all appropriate health safety precautions.

DUE TO CORONAVIRUS COVID-19, NO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE
ALLOWED INTO THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS DURING CARSON COUNCIL
MEETINGS.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION  OUR  CARSON  CITY  COUNCIL
MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

• Livestream on the City’s website:  The meeting will be conducted live over the
internet via http://ci.carson.ca.us

•  Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

Any members of the public wishing to provide public comment for the items on the
agenda may do so as follows:
1. Email:  You can email comments to cityclerk@carson.ca.us  or through the

2.. CONSIDER DISASTER COUNCIL RECOMMENDATIONS (CITY COUNCIL) MPT - support with the recommendations with CCBS 
motioned MPT second Hicks

Sharon - led into the events section

Robert Lennox: gave a presentation on Notable Retired Protocols in Covid 19; 

Supplied a PowerPoint presentation of upcoming until October 2021

Relay for Life postponed until August 2021

MPT: question regarding 4th of July Community Friendship Day to July 11, 2021, maybe in person, zoom (change status to proceed from postponed), to 7/14/21
Hicks - White Linen event proceed with a modify motion
to proceed if they already started the planning
motion to direct staff to come back with the details

Gospelfest in September to fill the spot, date to be determined.

Mayor complimented the staff on the Juneteenth celebration



ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (COUNCIL MEMBERS)

ADJOURNMENT

3.. CONSIDER A CO-SPONSORSHIP REQUEST FOR THE ADULT REAL RUN BASKETBALL LEAGUE  (CITY COUNCIL) Robert Lennox gave Staff Report; 
Robert introduced DeAnthony Langston to speak on Nike Real Run Enterprise Inc. 
City to Co-sponsor the adult basketball with a waiver of fees for facility use valued at $21,729.00 for all hours and evening games;
requesting assistance for the City's summer youth workers

Langston - thanked the Mayor and Councilmembers for their support

the league is totally free to the community and surrounding colleges participating with teams

conclude the league with a big Carson day for the community

Major media outlets will be present.

MPT Dear asked Lennox about the two monetary figures in the staff report, but Langston mentioned 3 monetary figures;

MPT Dear wants to make sure he has built into his program ethnic, age, and neighborhood diversity? Langston responded with yes he has it built into the program

Counc. Hicks: when dealing with the children what other programs will you have in place to keep the kids involved? Langston said yes they will continue what they did in the past.

Hicks: how will you deal with travel ball teams and those kids participating?  This is not a competitive league but recreational

Mayor Davis is not interested in travel ball teams coming and being competitive, but wants the kids who are learning.

Mayor: reach out to Nike to sponsor the Little Run uniforms and tennis shoes; Program will be run by Parks & Recreation

Counc. Hilton: excited about the Real Run coming to Carson,

hilton motion to approve request
